name: appshots-mcp

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Every enumerated value the other tools accept: device classes with their exact export pixel sizes, layout templates, real-device bezel ids, built-in font families, App Store locale codes and shape kinds.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Start a new project and make it the open one. The template decides the layout of every page — call list_options for the catalog, which says which devices and page counts each one takes. Most templates lay a painted background image (a locked "Background art" layer) under each page, matching the colour way; set_background replaces it with the colour you ask for.

device.description: Target store listing size; call list_options for the pixel dimensions of each.

pages.description: Screenshots in the set (App Store allows up to 10).

locale.description: Base locale, e.g. en-US or zh-Hans.

orientation.description: Ignored for devices locked to one orientation (Mac, Watch, Feature Graphic).

template.description: Layout to seed the pages with; call list_options for the full catalog.

theme.description: Colour way to build the template in; omit to use the template's own.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Load a saved project and make it the open one.

path.description: Path to a .appshots file; ~ is expanded.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Write the project to a .appshots file. With no path it saves back where it was opened from, or into ~/Documents/AppShots — the folder the desktop app lists on its home screen.

tools.name: describe_project
tools.description: The project settings plus every layer with its page, geometry (as fractions and as pixels) and ids. Call this to get layer ids before update_layer / remove_layer.

tools.name: configure_project
tools.description: Rename, switch the default locale, map locales to fonts, or name the pages.

defaultLocale.description: Locale used when a text layer has no string for the active one.

localeFontMap.description: Locale (or language prefix, e.g. "ja") → font family, overriding each text layer's own font.

backgroundPerPanel.description: true = repeat the background on every page; false = one gradient stretched across the whole band.

tools.name: set_background
tools.description: Paint the whole band, or one page when `page` is given. A gradient with backgroundPerPanel=false spans the pages continuously, which is what makes a panorama set read as one image. Removes the template's painted background art from the pages it paints, since that art would cover it.

stops.description: Optional multi-stop gradient; `from`/`to` still drive the swatch preview.

page.description: Omit to set the shared background for the whole band.

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Place text on a page. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels. Supply one string per locale in `texts`; missing locales fall back to the default one. Text auto-shrinks for locales whose translation runs longer, so leave headroom below the box.

page.description: 1-based page number, matching the page labels in the app.

texts.description: Locale code → string, e.g. {"en-US": "Track every workout", "zh-Hans": "记录每一次训练"}.

x.description: Left edge. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels.

y.description: Top edge. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels.

width.description: Text box width. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels.

fontSize.description: Font size as a fraction of PAGE HEIGHT (0.036 ≈ a headline).

fontFamily.description: Built-in family (list_options); defaults to Inter, or Noto Sans SC for zh.

tools.name: add_frame
tools.description: Place a device frame on a page. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels. Only `width` is taken — the height follows the device's real aspect ratio. Pass `screenshot` to drop an image straight into the screen, or fill frames later with import_screenshots.

page.description: 1-based page number, matching the page labels in the app.

x.description: Left edge. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels.

y.description: Top edge. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels.

width.description: Frame width. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels. Height is derived, never passed.

screenshot.description: Path to the screenshot image to show inside the frame.

locale.description: Which locale that screenshot belongs to (default: the project default).

bezel.description: Real-device bezel id from list_options; omit for the default one.

statusBar.description: Draw an iOS status bar over the screenshot.

tools.name: add_shape
tools.description: Place a shape on a page. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels. Sizes omitted fall back to the editor's per-shape defaults.

page.description: 1-based page number, matching the page labels in the app.

x.description: Left edge. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels.

y.description: Top edge. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels.

strokeWidth.description: Stroke width. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius (rect). Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels.

tools.name: add_image
tools.description: Place an image (logo, badge, illustration) on a page. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels. Give `width` alone and the height follows the image's aspect ratio.

page.description: 1-based page number, matching the page labels in the app.

path.description: Path to a png/jpg/webp/gif/svg on disk; ~ is expanded.

x.description: Left edge. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels.

y.description: Top edge. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels.

tools.name: update_layer
tools.description: Patch one layer; only the fields given change. Fraction of one page (0 = left/top edge, 1 = full page width/height), not pixels. Use `raw` for anything not covered here — it merges straight into the layer object in its own units (e.g. {"fill":"#ff0055"}, {"fontSize":120}, {"fillGradient":{...}}).

page.description: Move the layer to another page, keeping its position within the page.

tools.name: set_locales
tools.description: Replace the locale list. Text layers keep a string per locale; frames can hold a screenshot per locale. Translate the copy yourself and write it with set_text — the app needs no translation service.

locales.description: App Store locale codes; see list_options.

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Write (or overwrite) the copy for a single locale. Adds the locale to the project if new.

tools.name: import_screenshots
tools.description: Walk a folder of screenshots and drop each into the right frame. Recognises the fastlane layout (screenshots/<locale>/whatever_01.png), a locale prefix (en-US_01.png), or a bare index (01.png); the trailing number is the page. Files with no index are assigned in order per locale.

dir.description: Folder to walk recursively; ~ is expanded.

locale.description: Locale for files whose name says nothing (default: the project default).

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Render pages of the open project and return them as images, so you can see what you actually composed and fix it. Renders the unsaved in-memory project through the editor's own renderer, so it matches what the app would export. Use it after laying out a page and before save_project.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers; omit for every page.

items.description: 1-based page number, matching the page labels in the app.

locale.description: Which locale's copy to draw (default: the project default).

maxWidth.description: Preview width in px. Keep it small — this is for looking, not for exporting.

tools.name: export_screenshots
tools.description: Render every page at the exact store pixel size and write them into a folder, in the layout fastlane deliver expects: <dir>/screenshots/<locale>/<device>_<orientation>_<nn>.png. Renders through the editor's own path, so the files match what the app's Export button produces.

dir.description: Output folder; created if missing. ~ is expanded.

locales.description: Locales to export; omit for every locale in the project.

pages.description: 1-based page numbers; omit for every page.

items.description: 1-based page number, matching the page labels in the app.

instructions:
Design App Store / Google Play screenshot projects and save them as .appshots files.

Workflow: create_project → set_background → add_frame/add_text per page → save_project.
The user then opens the file in AppShots to review and export the PNGs.

ALL geometry is a fraction of one page (0..1), never pixels — so the same numbers
work on a 410px watch and a 2880px Mac. Layers are addressed by page number.
Call list_options for the valid devices, bezels, fonts, locales and shape kinds.
